targets.temperature: Retained original outdoor temperature pairs at leads 1–24 hours; raw native station mean plus separately refitted existing seven residual predictors
targets.wind: Retained complete measured scalar wind-hour means; baseline is the retained adjacent-native-instant mean, never gust or mean-vector magnitude
targets.thermal: Task4 retained comparable passive-action measured indoor-air-change pairs at 1/6/12/24 hours; same total-only six-feature empirical response baseline

populations.historical: Retrospective assumed source readiness at initialization+9h and counterfactual target/measurement readiness; actual acquisition and receipt clocks retained; not operational issuance
populations.recorded: Actual ingestion completion, no later source at an earlier origin; original label availability determines operational eligibility; analyzed separately
populations.cohorts: Keep source class, target definition, sensor/quality/policy, grid, lead horizon and thermal action eligibility distinct; no health qualification from persisted numeric history
populations.sampling: All eligible retained near-term temperature and scalar wind pairs and Task4 comparable thermal pairs; fail on capacity rather than outcome-based sampling

feature_times.temperature: At original future valid target time from the same immutable forecast snapshot
feature_times.wind: Average the original native values at the measured hour boundaries; direction is normalized from averaged compatible u/v, not average bearings
feature_times.thermal: Time-average each raw instant forecast quantity over the original origin-to-target window using piecewise linear native-hour values and exact fractional endpoints; never observed future weather
feature_times.missing: Complete compatible original source/native asset/grid/time support required per group; absent/calm direction and missing layers are unavailable, never zero-filled or borrowed from later acquisition

candidates.group_ablations: Each individual group versus an independently refitted same-base candidate on exactly the same eligible target/origin rows; no combined-group search
candidates.temperature_thermal: Training-only standardized bounded ridge residual response; fixed ridge grid 0.01,0.1,1; additive correction bounded to ±15C equivalent
candidates.wind_gain: Separate gain-only benchmark using frozen equal-date/target/forecast training weights, prior24target shrinkage, gain clipped to0.25–4; new identity preserves old gain/v2 semantics
candidates.wind_challenger: One bounded affine log1p scalar-wind family: training-only standardized ridge response in log1p space, fixed ridge grid0.01,0.1,1; prediction expm1 clipped0–200m/s; individual groups ablate against this same base family
candidates.production_models: Unchanged; no source/model promotion, PV cooling wind changes, new action authority or statistical qualification

fitting.outer_split: Last third of eligible local measured-target dates, using all base population dates before group availability filtering
fitting.training: Rolling earlier completed target dates, maximum28days; target completion before origin, and actual label availability before origin for recorded operational evidence
fitting.inner_selection: Last third of earlier training dates only; fixed ridges evaluated chronologically with earlier inner training and unchanged minimum support
fitting.weighting: Equal local target dates, then equal unique measured targets, then equal original forecasts; outcome identities and source/quality cohorts retained
fitting.actual_completion_times: Retain real completed-at timestamps for fitted artifacts; hypothetical historical readiness remains a separate explicit experiment clock

reporting.selection: Frozen general3percent improvement/5percent subgroup regression policy; retain incumbent unless separately reviewed
reporting.uncertainty: Paired target-date blocks, original forecasts stay together; descriptive support and missing regimes explicit, no temporal-independence or probability qualification inferred
reporting.missing_support: Named per-group reason and complete candidate software/fixtures; no invented direction/layer evidence
